title: Closing remarks for the 2026 Seoul Marathon and the 96th Dong-A Marathon
publisher: Seoul Marathon Organizing Committee (The Dong-A Ilbo)
claims: The 2026 race was the 96th Dong-A Marathon, held on 15 March 2026, with 40,000 runners participating.
The race has been Korea's only World Athletics Platinum Label road race for seven consecutive years and is recognised with a World Athletics Heritage Plaque.
The inaugural Seoul Running Expo was held alongside the 2026 race.

Supporters listed: Seoul Metropolitan Government, Seoul Metropolitan Sports Council, Korea Association of Athletics Federations, Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, Korea Sports Promotion Foundation; partners adidas, KB Financial Group, Samyang, Cass, AceBiome, aminoVITAL, Zamst, Pocari Sweat and Hanjin.
The organising committee thanked the Dongma Crew volunteers and looked ahead to the 97th edition.
